Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.<br><br>This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.</p></div><p>With the Okta's Auth0 organization’s increased dedication to ensuring customer availability expectations are exceeded in every way, you will play a key role as we evolve our system architecture to meet the demands of enormous growth and support the hundreds of millions of users who rely on us to provide uninterrupted access to business-critical</p> <p>Reporting to the Manager of Engineering, in this role as a SRE Operations Engineer, you will ensure smooth operations of our Customer Identity Cloud at Okta. Working closely with the SRE team, your primary focus will be on ensuring production systems remain operational at all times, while continually setting and achieving long-term operational success for the platform with potential career growth into Site Reliability Engineering.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Executes operational work including updating/patching and maintaining the Engineering Service Desk queue</li> <li>Responsible for ensuring team requests are triaged and/or actioned in a timely manner</li> <li>Monitors Platform health and take steps to alleviate issues related to deployment and operations</li> <li>Assist with capacity, performance and scalability testing where required</li> <li>Escalation point for Platform issues from customer support teams</li> <li>Execute runbooks and update processes as required</li> <li>Interface with the SRE team to report core issues, required improvements and new feature requests</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring to the role</strong></p> <ul> <li>General platform infrastructure knowledge, including high availability / load balancing concepts, routers, firewalls</li> <li>and storage subsystems</li> <li>Sound understanding of protocols/technologies like HTTP, SSL, SSH and Kubernetes</li> <li>Familiarity with a variety of open source technologies and tools like MongoDB, NodeJS&nbsp;</li> <li>Knowledge of terraform is good to have</li> <li>Familiarity with a cloud platforms like AWS and Azure is desired&nbsp;</li> <li>Linux fundamentals and knowledge of tools like Datadog&nbsp; are good to have&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with monitoring and troubleshooting techniques</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly with a diverse range of stakeholders across multiple domains</li> <li>Multi tasking and time management skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience in the following</strong></p> <ul> <li>1+ years in a Cloud Operations role</li> <li>1+ years in a production environment supporting large-scale, mission-critical applications</li> <li>Interest and/or an understanding of programming e.g. golang, shell scripting</li> </ul> <p>#P20445_3457382</p> <p>#LI_Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>The Okta Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><a href="http://rewards.okta.com">Supporting Your Well-Being</a>&nbsp;</li> <li><a href="https://www.okta.com/company/okta-for-good/">Driving Social Impact&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.okta.com/company/talent-connection-community/">Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community</a></li> </ul> <p>We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.<br><br>Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws.<br><br>If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete any part of the job application, interview process, or onboarding please&nbsp;<a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1EfiEYZrIyhA2X4Fijk0R3RKYOzNoS3wtvyM4nhbZnXE/edit">use this Form</a> to request an accommodation.<br><br>Notice for New York City Applicants &amp; Employees: Okta may use Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT), as defined by New York City Local Law 144, that use artificial intelligence, machine learning, or other automated processes to assist in our recruitment and hiring process. <p>MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/post/stack-overflow-research-most-wanted-database">#1 most wanted database</a>, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.</p> <p>To support this growth, we are expanding our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/post/transitioning-teacher-mongodbs-new-enterprise-modernization-team-meet-gabriela-preiss">Industry Solutions Team</a> (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.</p> <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.</p> <p>This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.</p> <p>We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.</p> <h3>What you’ll do at MongoDB</h3> <p>In this role, you will</p> <ul> <li>Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment</li> <li>Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions</li> <li>Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover</li> <li>Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments</li> <li>Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries</li> <li>Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements</li> </ul> <h3>As an ideal candidate, you will have</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications</li> <li>Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics</li> <li>Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions</li> <li>Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout</li> <li>Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments</li> <li>Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly</li> <li>Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region</li> </ul> <h3>As an ideal candidate, you may also have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role</li> <li>Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews</li> <li>Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries</li> <li>Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio</li> </ul> <h3>What you will learn</h3> <ul> <li>Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills</li> <li>Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions</li> </ul> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.&nbsp;</p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</p> <p>MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.</p> <p><em>Req ID -3273528250</em></p>

<p>We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our growing Gurugram Products &amp; Technology team to develop and expand core parts of a new platform we are building to make it easier for customers to build AI applications using MongoDB.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Software Engineer on this new team, you will be responsible for developing cutting edge technologies related to enabling deployment at scale of AI applications. You will take on challenging, high-visibility projects that improve and enhance the performance, scalability, and reliability of the distributed systems infrastructure for this new product. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living MongoDB cultural values every day – we value intellectual curiosity and honesty, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.</p> <h3><strong>Position Expectations</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Writing and testing software in commonly used high level programming languages, such as Go, Python, Java, Javascript and others.</li> <li>Design, build and deliver well-tested core pieces of the platform in collaboration with other vested parties</li> <li>Maintaining a balance between delivering software and performing research and development</li> <li>Working closely with cross functional teams to create end user features that deliver quality software to our clients</li> <li>A workplace culture where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work - we believe that Embracing the Power of Differences is the best way to broaden our own perspectives and foster innovation</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Must have completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field</li> <li>Have a foundation in computer science theory, with competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design</li> <li>Minimum experience of 6 months to 3 years, internship experience is also accepted</li> <li>Proficient in one of our commonly used languages which include Go, Python, Java, Javascript, C++, or comparable high level programming languages</li> <li>Experience writing and testing software whether as part of an internship, in a personal project, in a coding competition, or for research</li> <li>Good verbal and written technical communication skills, desire to collaborate with colleagues</li> <li>Eager to learn, with a strong technical background</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About MongoDB</strong></h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and nearly 60,000 customers—including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups—relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.&nbsp;</p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</p> <p>MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.</p>
